expected.libraries_bundling_condition: server.javaFlavor == .neoforge || server.javaFlavor == .forge (source line 181). A vanilla/fabric/purpur server never bundles libraries/ even when the directory exists on disk -- that check is a flavor gate, not an existence check.

notes: NeoForge/Forge servers launch via @unix_args.txt rather than a bundled paper.jar (apply-side comment at source line 438), so bundledPaperJar is naturally false here even though the flavor gate for jar-bundling (isJava, line 156) would otherwise apply -- this fixture's jar is simply never on disk to begin with, which is the common case for this flavor. Contrast fixtures/transfer-package/no-bundled-paper-jar.json, where a Paper server's jar is *expected* but happens to be missing -- same observable manifest field (bundledPaperJar: false), different real-world cause. mods/ here bundles via the same wholesale sub-list as plugins/ (source line 169, ["world_slots", "backups", "plugins", "mods", "resource-packs"]) -- it is not Forge-specific, a Paper server with a mods/ directory would bundle it too.
